title: Why the Biggest Edges Lie the Most
deck: Sort your bets by edge and start at the top. It feels like discipline. Three weeks of our own ledger show why the bets that look best on paper are the ones most likely to be a mistake.

hero.alt: Jonathan Marchessault battles in front of the Seattle net, watched by Vince Dunn and goaltender Joey Daccord, at the 2024 Winter Classic
